name: Gasthof Felsenstuberl
beschreibung: The Gasthof Felsenstuberl is located in Tyrol, Austria. The accommodation offers a welcoming and traditional Tyrolean atmosphere. Guests will discover a cosy guest house serving delightful regional cuisine. The surrounding area is distinguished by an impressive alpine mountain landscape. Hiking trails and scenic outdoor experiences are readily available nearby. Amenities feature comfortable rooms and a rustic dining lounge. The inn serves as a convenient starting point for excursions into the mountains.
